steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Content theories: Maslow (hierarchy), Herzberg (hygiene/motivators), McClelland (need achiev/affil/power); Process: Vroom (expectancy), Adams (equity)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Styles: Autocratic (decides alone), Democratic (consults), Laissez-faire (delegates); Situational: telling/selling/participating/delegating; Transformational: inspire, intellectually stimulate

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Tall: many layers, narrow span; Flat: few layers, wide span; Centralised: top decides; Decentralised: delegated; Matrix: dual reporting

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Recruitment: job description, person spec; Internal vs external; Selection: CV, interview (structured/unstructured), psychometric, assessment centre

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Apply Herzberg to a call centre with high turnover. Propose changes --- Solution: Hygiene factors: pay, conditions, supervision, policy -> ensure competitive pay, ergonomic chairs, supportive managers, fair policies. Motivators: achievement, recognition, responsibility, growth -> team targets with bonuses, employee of month, job enrichment (team leader roles), career path to management

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Compare Maslow vs Herzberg | Apply Vroom expectancy to sales commission | Evaluate transformational leadership in crisis
